claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market Street (printed as 'No. G19 Market street') advertised a free concert every evening, with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world, No. G19 Market street. Free concert every evening; best of singers only engaged

claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world, No. G19 Market street

notes: Advertisement only; the number is printed as G19, read as 619 from other notices. Army orders and other news on the page do not involve Allen.
